title: Parallel JPEG processing on CompSOC
summary: Built a lock-free FIFO library and benchmarked parallel JPEG decoding on a multicore RISC-V platform.
description:
For the Embedded Systems Laboratory, our two-person team built libmyfifo, a lightweight single-producer/single-consumer FIFO library for communication between partitions on the CompSOC platform. We also implemented four JPEG decoding variants: a sequential baseline and data-parallel, function-parallel and hybrid-parallel versions.

For 16-byte tokens, our FIFO reduced communication cost from 786 to 322 cycles per token compared with the provided library, a speedup of about 2.4x. Across the non-trivial images in our benchmark, data parallelism achieved a 2.87x geometric-mean speedup over sequential decoding; function parallelism achieved 2.80x and the hybrid approach 2.38x. We validated the decoded output and investigated how communication overhead, task mapping and synchronization affected performance and real-time behaviour.
